title: Landscaping Visit Service Request Form
subtitle: Commercial Landscaping Visit: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Landscaping Visit Service Request Form covers grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task. The grounds service coordinator records Commercial Landscaping Visit need, timing, access, and assignment. Landscaping Visit Service Request Form keeps Commercial Landscaping Visit exceptions visible until the grounds service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Landscaping Visit Service Request Form at property zone, bed, lawn area, slope, walkway, and equipment access route. Document grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task identity before Commercial Landscaping Visit begins. Compare grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task findings with stated Commercial Landscaping Visit criteria; route unresolved Commercial Landscaping Visit issues to landscape operations supervisor.

sections.guidance: For Commercial Landscaping Visit, identify responsible parties, property zone, bed, lawn area, slope, walkway, and equipment access route, and the linked grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task source.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Commercial Landscaping Visit request when a public-access hazard, weather stop, chemical boundary, or uncontrolled property condition remains. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to grounds service coordinator.
